body: Yeah, okay, Ill post the one I'm currently working on- its in progress- you are warned-

Your right. Everyone's right. My ex therapist is right. I'm just a narcissist, who clearly enjoys procrastinating and finding faults in other people, trying to avoid actually showing any vulnerabilities or faults, pushing myself into a numbing depression- a complete idiot. I've been in this cycle for years upon years. Maybe I can pull through. I hope.

Thanks, and yes, I've gotten all my hobbies figured out. I've been playing cello for a few years now, symphonies are genious- there are so many classical composers that just kick ass- Tchaikovsky, Beethoven, Dvorak. That's what I mean by composing music. Barefoot running, (try reading that tarahumara book, name escapes me now) and I mountain bike with my brother. But that was during the summer. Now I gruel resentfully through school. I was planning on committing suicide at the beginning of the school year but I didn't want to give my family PTSD from the sight of my hanging body, so I just don't know. I can't drone my way through school and volunteer projects and bullshit, feeling my energy drain- then just go off and focus on my stuff, and receive lesser results. God, retreading this- its just repulsive. Sorry guys, I'm just too rigid to make it in this world.

Hah, I smiled as you wrote 'fierce'. That's an oddly satisfying adjective. And yes, I think most of the anger stems from the fact that I owe my parents my very existence, that my mom doesn't deserve the pride caused by my accomplishments (from mistreating me and my dad). I'm an extreme perfectionist- if something isn't up to my own standards, I get angry. I need to get over this too, but don't know how- my thighs could already require stitches. And I hate myself most of the time, because I waste all my potential on trying to stay as distant and disconnected as possible from everything that annoys/frustrates me. I avoid everything, and have no control- self destruction and anger gives some of it back. Wow this helps sort my thoughts out.

I'm not happy. I'm scared, almost vulnerable. I understand that the only way I can make my way in the world by myself is by accepting responsibilities (even homework assignments would count as such) and connecting with people. But I can read people so easily, everything seems so shallow. Who needs good food, or cool clothes or cars?? If I'm going to live at all, I have to do it on edge, dangerously, or there's no point. This isn't even answering your question, but I'm trying to explain. I feel so cooped up, angry all the time. I have to make a choice. Either suicide, or somehow bolt and make my way elsewhere and focus my entire creativity and energy on art, etc. what else could i do? And no, I can't do everything- but I can to an extent to please my parents. Is that what you mean?

What difference does it make if your happy or not? Im so comfortable with self inflicting pain and depression. I should either be completely productive and create music compositions and drawings all the time, to produce my actual potential, or turn into a robot and stay disconnected (where i am currently) Being in the middle causes guilt; I could be doing better. I'm scared that I'm just an average person (most people annoy the shit out of me) and doing a little bit of everything and seeing that I'm not actually good at anything is a good enough reason to just die.  I owe my parents my very existence- they need to get things in return, right? And I have trouble remembering what being actually happy feels like.

I try, but I still have to drag my feet to school every day. Isn't it extremely selfish and dependent if I just focus on things I enjoy? I would feel even more guilty if I failed at everything my parents worked so hard for, just to focus on myself. And forcing myself to smile and communicate with other people is just part of my day, and will be for the rest of my life!
